facts.statement: Binance's official Security Incident Update #2, published 2026-10-30 19:33 UTC, announced an initial Proof of Reserves snapshot within 12 hours and results by 2026-11-02. The 12-hour target elapsed at approximately 2026-10-31 07:33 UTC.
At 2026-10-31 12:31:30 UTC, the rendered Binance public Proof of Reserves page showed blank Audit Time, Verification Mechanism, Merkle Root Hash and address-download metadata.

Main remained at c779b26c68e7e3f0fa50dd99cc2f03c58e198148. The open-PR inventory contained 185 PRs: 175 drafts, 10 ready, 183 main-based, 181 stale main bases, two current-main bases (#1411 and #1412), and two non-main bases.

Main scheduler-tick.yml grants contents:write and actions:write, invokes scheduler.py tick with GH_TOKEN, and commits/pushes queue state to main. scheduler.py accepts any existing workflow file as a target; no strict workflow allowlist is implemented.
The main schedule queue contained one historical completed entry and zero pending entries at the time of inspection.
PR #1412 proposes a read-only scheduler queue audit. Its exact-head CI passed 344 tests and 8 subtests; the fail-closed gate passed with merging disabled. It remains open, draft and unmerged.
PR #1411 proposes disabling the unsafe Databricks token-input workflow, but it remains open, draft and unmerged; the unsafe workflow is still present on main.

claims.claim: Binance allocated more than $6.34B in company funds, held approximately $5B in affected token assets and was acquiring the remaining approximately $1.34B; it reported approximately $3B frozen on-chain.
Binance expected results of its initial PoR snapshot by 2026-11-02.

inferences.statement: The blank rendered PoR fields do not establish that no snapshot was taken; the page may be dynamically populated or publication may lag. The public result remains unverified.
No XRP-specific replenishment quantity can be inferred from the aggregate approximately $1.34B acquisition plan.

The scheduler's broad dispatch permission creates a high-impact execution path because a due queue entry can name any existing workflow file. The currently empty pending queue reduces immediate queued-work exposure but does not remove the structural permission risk.

hypotheses.statement: Binance completed the initial snapshot but public report fields are not yet rendered or published.
counter_hypotheses: The snapshot was delayed or not completed by the target.
disconfirming_evidence: The public page fields were blank at the observation time.

hypotheses.statement: A modified or malicious scheduler queue entry could dispatch a sensitive existing workflow through the main scheduler's actions:write capability.
counter_hypotheses: Workflow-specific triggers, inputs or permissions may prevent a particular target from completing.
disconfirming_evidence: The inspected queue had zero pending entries and no dispatch was performed.

hypotheses.statement: A temporary read-only scheduler audit is a low-risk containment step while durable non-main queue state and a strict allowlist are designed.
counter_hypotheses: Pausing dispatch delays future scheduled work if new tasks are queued.
disconfirming_evidence: No pending queue entries existed at the time of the change.

unknowns: Whether Binance actually took the initial PoR snapshot by 2026-10-31 07:33 UTC; the public report result remains unverified.
Token-specific reserve balances, customer liabilities, XRP purchases, acquisition venues and completed reserve-address crosswalk.
Whether the blank rendered PoR metadata reflects dynamic page rendering or a publication delay.
Whether any future scheduler queue entry would target a workflow that can complete under its own event, input and permission constraints.
A durable non-main queue-state mechanism and strict workflow/input allowlist have not yet been implemented.
The approval workflow's zero-job push failure root cause remains unknown.
Full repository CI, dependency vulnerability scanning and branch-protection details remain incomplete.

disconfirming.finding: The current queue contained one completed historical entry and zero pending entries; no scheduled work was discarded by the proposed quarantine.
The blank Proof of Reserves page is not conclusive evidence that no snapshot was taken because dynamic rendering and publication lag remain possible.
The approximately $1.34B aggregate remaining token-acquisition plan does not identify XRP as an allocated purchase asset.

limitations: Binance's public Proof of Reserves page rendered blank audit-time, verification-mechanism, Merkle-root and address-download fields at 2026-10-31 12:31:30 UTC. Dynamic rendering or publication lag remain possible; this does not prove that the announced snapshot was not taken.

Binance's approximately $1.34B remaining affected-token acquisition plan is aggregate. No XRP-specific purchase quantity, execution venue, timing or completed reserve-address crosswalk has been disclosed.
PR #1412 is a draft proposal. Main's scheduler retains contents:write/actions:write and broad workflow dispatch authority until an authorized merge; this run did not change main.

The read-only scheduler proposal intentionally pauses future automatic queue dispatch if merged. The inspected queue had one historical completed entry and zero pending entries; a durable non-main queue-state and strict workflow/input allowlist design is still required.
Full repository CI, dependency vulnerability scanning and complete branch-protection details remain incomplete. Eight external AI platforms remain unauthenticated and have no verified live handoffs.
